children: Overview
Global sports technology brand's Q3 2026 revenue fell 9.9% yr/yr, mainly due to supply constraints
Adjusted net loss for Q3 widened yr/yr, driven by higher costs and marketing investment
Company extended share repurchase program for another year, repurchased US$17.8 mln to date
Outlook
Zepp Health expects Q4 2026 revenue between $90.0 mln and $95.0 mln
Company sees Q4 revenue rising 6% to 12% year-over-year
Company says improving product availability and expanded distribution channels to support revenue growth
Result Drivers
SUPPLY CONSTRAINTS - Co said tight supply for core products, especially higher-margin items like Helio Strap and Balance 3, weighed on revenue and limited ability to meet demand
HIGHER COMPONENT COSTS - Elevated memory and other component costs, particularly in entry-level products, put pressure on gross margin and contributed to increased net loss
INCREASED MARKETING SPEND - Higher selling and marketing expenses, including new product launches, athlete partnerships, and sponsorships, drove up operating expenses and widened net loss
